title: Blaym for Jupyter
description: Recording settings. They apply when a notebook is next opened.

typingPauseMs.title: Typing pause (ms)
typingPauseMs.description: A typing step ends after this much quiet. Applies when the notebook is next opened.

typingMaxMs.title: Longest typing step (ms)
typingMaxMs.description: A typing step also ends after this much continuous typing. Applies when the notebook is next opened.

aiWindowMs.title: AI match window (ms)
aiWindowMs.description: How close an AI action must be to a change to mark it as made by the AI.

heartbeatMs.title: Heartbeat (ms)
heartbeatMs.description: How often the page tells the server that it is still recording. Applies when the notebook is next opened.

retryFirstMs.title: First retry delay (ms)
retryFirstMs.description: Delay before the first retry when the server does not answer; doubles up to the longest delay. Applies when the notebook is next opened.

retryMaxMs.title: Longest retry delay (ms)
retryMaxMs.description: Retry delay. Applies when the notebook is next opened.

runWaitMs.title: Wait for a run's code (ms)
runWaitMs.description: How long the server waits for the code of a run to arrive.

runWaitAliveMs.title: Wait for a run's code while the page is alive (ms)
